about: Parallel progression trees beside the skill tree. Every node is verified by evidence the app can count (links he files, public GitHub days, building hours from commits, money-log income, mastered skill nodes, Life points), never by a button press. Thresholds are first steps for a third-year ECE student, meant to be raised later.
